about: C3b/C3c the jank walk on foot by his wreck, by real input: out of the car (E), then walk into his car's middle, into his window (he stays in his seat: C3c), into my own car's middle, out to the river's rail and along the road; [C3c, after the critic] then straight into the river's rail (24 m out) and into the west facades (40 m): the rail and the warehouses' fronts stop me, never over the water or inside a building; every 100 ms the eye is checked against the two cars' boxes and the man (nothing passes through anything). Then back in by E at the door. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_jank_walk.json

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; window.__jw = { inside: [], n: 0, minMan: 9 }; setInterval(() => { const C2 = G.scenes.ctx && G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; if (!C2 || C2.phase !== 'out') return; const e = G.controller.pos; window.__jw.n++; for (const v of [C2.my, C2.his]) { const l = v.local(e); if (Math.abs(l.x) < v.spec.halfL && Math.abs(l.z) < v.spec.halfW) window.__jw.inside.push(v.kind + ' ' + l.x.toFixed(2) + ',' + l.z.toFixed(2)); } }, 100); return JSON.stringify({ my: [C.my.pos.x, C.my.pos.z], his: [C.his.pos.x, C.his.pos.z], win: C.winP, eye: [G.controller.pos.x, G.controller.pos.z] }); })()

steps.look: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, K = G.controller, t = ([C.his.pos.x, C.his.pos.z]); const want = Math.atan2(-(t[0] - K.pos.x), -(t[1] - K.pos.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - K.yaw), Math.cos(want - K.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / K.sensitivity), 0]; })()

steps.name: [C3c, after the critic] into the river's rail: across the quay, 24 m out

steps.walk: (async () => { const P = await import('/src/stages/city/plan.js'); const e = G.controller.pos; const s = P.riverSAtZ(e.z); const out = []; for (const k of [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]) { const p = P.riverPoint(s, -24 * k); out.push([p.x, p.z]); } return out; })()

steps.eval: (async () => { const P = await import('/src/stages/city/plan.js'); const e = G.controller.pos; const s = P.riverSAtZ(e.z); const F = P.riverFrame(s, {}); const d = (e.x - F.x) * F.rx + (e.z - F.z) * F.rz; const T = G.stage.track; const inWall = T.boxes.filter((b) => b.tag === 'wall' || b.tag === 'fence').some((b) => { const lx = (e.x - b.cx) * b.c - (e.z - b.cz) * b.s, lz = (e.x - b.cx) * b.s + (e.z - b.cz) * b.c; return Math.abs(lx) < b.hx && Math.abs(lz) < b.hz; }); window.__jd = { d: +d.toFixed(2), inWall, eye: [+e.x.toFixed(2), +e.z.toFixed(2)] }; return JSON.stringify(window.__jd); })()
